shortDescription.default: Formwright - design custom SharePoint list forms without Power Apps

longDescription.default: Adds a "Customize forms" button to every list that opens a drag-and-drop form designer, plus a form customizer that replaces the list's New, Edit and Display forms and a web part that puts a form on any page. Layouts with sections, tabs and wizards; conditional visibility, required and read-only rules; calculated and default values; validation; cascading lookups; audience-specific forms; approval buttons; and inline related items. Uses only SharePoint REST APIs - no Azure AD app registration and no Power Apps.

features.title: Formwright Feature
features.description: Adds the "Customize forms" command to lists and libraries, the Formwright form customizer and the Formwright - Form web part.
